subject: Finalizing dry-run window & data gating before pilot demo
messages:
From: Becky Nolan <becky@beaconhealth.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Aaron Lee <aaron.lee@beaconhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Pilot demo on Nov 18 — request for extra prep window

Hi Rishi / Marissa,

Thanks again for the invite to run through the pilot on Nov 18. The product team here is excited — we want to make sure the demo reflects a realistic Beacon workload. Two asks from our side:

- Can we schedule a 60–90 minute internal dry run where your team can validate our sample payloads and the workload traces? That helps us avoid surprises during the customer-facing session.
- We need a short access validation window so we can confirm RBAC and S3 paths (we'll provide a read-only role).

We have travel for several team members that week: some will be onsite Nov 19–20, so Nov 18 is our preference for the customer-facing demo if possible. If you need to move it to align with your engineers, we're flexible but want the dry run beforehand.

Thanks — happy to propose times.

Best,
Becky Nolan
Head of Data Integrations
Beacon Health

[Attachment hints: will share sample CSVs after internal sign-off]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Becky Nolan <becky@beaconhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot demo on Nov 18 — request for extra prep window

Hi Becky — thanks for the heads up and the context. Quick note: I will be traveling and on customer visits Nov 17–19, so Nov 18 will be difficult for me to lead the demo. I can be present remotely on Nov 19 afternoon PT, or we can keep Nov 18 and I’ll hand off facilitation to Marissa/Connor, but I’d strongly prefer to keep an internal dry run before the public demo so we can check prompt sets and run the sample workload through our staging cluster.

Options that would work from our side:
- Option A: internal dry run on Tue Nov 17, 2:00–3:30 PM PT; customer-facing demo on Wed Nov 18 at your preferred time with Marissa as primary host.
- Option B: internal dry run on Tue Nov 17, 2:00–3:30 PM PT; customer-facing demo moved to Thu Nov 19 10:00–11:00 AM ET so I can host.

If you can share the sample payloads and a short description of the workload traces you plan to show (token lengths, concurrency), we can validate quantization/latency tradeoffs beforehand.

—Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference

Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 11:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot demo on Nov 18 — request for extra prep window

Thanks Becky — this is straightforward to accommodate. Proposed plan from Redwood:

1) Internal dry run (staging) — Tue Nov 17, 2:00–3:30 PM PT. Goal: run Beacon sample payloads, exercise prompt sets, validate token/latency numbers, and confirm RBAC paths. Marissa & Connor will run the technical checklist; Priyom will verify data ingest.

2) Customer-facing demo — Thu Nov 19, 10:00–11:00 AM ET (we can keep Nov 18 if you're strongly tied to it, but this gives Rishi a chance to host).

Attachments: I am attaching our updated runbook and a stub sample payload CSV for you to review before the dry run. Please replace any sensitive values and confirm S3 path and role info prior to Nov 17.

[Attachment: redwood_runbook_v2.pdf]
[Attachment: beacon_sample_payloads.csv]

Next steps / asks:
- Becky: confirm the Nov 17 dry run and Nov 19 demo times.
- Becky: share the final sample CSV with any PII redacted, and provide the read-only role ARN or temporary credentials for the ingest bucket.

If those are good, I'll send calendar invites (dry run invite will be internal + a separate join link for Beacon).

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Marissa — this plan works for us. Confirming:

- Internal dry run: Tue Nov 17, 2:00–3:30 PM PT (Becky, Aaron, and two engineers from Beacon attending).
- Customer-facing demo: Thu Nov 19, 10:00–11:00 AM ET (we'll put the rest of the execs on the invite).

I'll upload the sanitized sample CSV to the Drive folder you shared and paste temporary read-only credentials in a separate secure message (security team will vet them). We may also send an additional small workload trace (50 short prompts, 5 medium prompts) to test caching behavior.

Thanks for being flexible — appreciate the clear options. Please send calendar invites for both times and a short pre-dry-run checklist (RBAC, endpoints, test tokens).

Best,
Becky
